target: very-general non-split Weil sixfold A_gen with K=Q(i), discriminant [-3], NS_Q=Q theta

families.input_theorem: Mukai: c(E)=(1+c1(E)/r)^r for rank-r semihomogeneous E (equivalently ch(E)=r exp(c1(E)/r) in rational cohomology).

families.family: finite shifts/direct sums/extensions/cones built from semihomogeneous bundles
families.law: Chern character is additive in K_0 for exact triangles and changes sign under odd shift.
families.codim3_constraint: ch_3 remains a Q-linear combination of semihomogeneous ch_3 values, hence remains in Q theta^3.
families.conclusion: Pi_W(ch_3)=0 for every object produced by finitely many of these operations.
families.hard_boundary: No claim is made for arbitrary direct summands/idempotent completion (thick closure). K_0 cancellation does not force the summands individually to remain in Q theta^3.

families.family: verified target-side Fourier-Mukai outputs that are semihomogeneous bundles up to shift
families.examples: Poincare/WIT transforms of nondegenerate line bundles and universal semihomogeneous-kernel transforms in the standard Mukai-Orlov-Gulbrandsen scope when the output is proved semihomogeneous on the target.
families.codim3_constraint: After the verified semihomogeneous-output step, the same formula ch_3=c1^3/(6r^2) applies; shifts only change sign.
families.hard_boundary: No blanket claim is made for an arbitrary Fourier-Mukai object unless its target-side output type/support is independently verified.

families.family: polarization/divisor classes acted on by target K-endomorphisms
families.law: For u=1+2i, u^*theta=5theta; more generally K-compatible endomorphisms preserve the one-dimensional NS_Q line.
families.codim3_constraint: The Q[K]-orbit of theta^3 is Q theta^3.
families.conclusion: K-endomorphism operations cannot turn divisor-generated degree-six input into W_K.

families.family: codimension-three Thom-Porteous / determinantal classes from bundles whose Chern classes lie in Q[theta]
families.law: Expected-codimension degeneracy classes are universal Schur polynomials in c(F-E).
families.codim3_constraint: If all Chern classes of F-E are in Q[theta], the codimension-three term is a scalar multiple of theta^3.
families.conclusion: Pi_W of the determinantal class is zero.
families.hard_boundary: Using a defining bundle/complex already carrying exceptional Chern data is not ruled out; it imports the missing seed rather than generating it.

families.family: arbitrary target-side or auxiliary algebraic correspondences
families.reason: The spectral projector Pi_W itself is an algebraic correspondence with cohomological image W_K, so a blanket claim that algebraic correspondences cannot access W_K is false. What remains missing is a known algebraic input sent to a nonzero W_K class.
families.unblock_condition: Construct an algebraic correspondence Gamma and an explicitly algebraic source class z with Pi_W(Gamma_*(z))≠0, or directly construct E with Pi_W(ch_3(E))≠0.
